notes.title: The Sundered Finisher Update Has Been Unleashed!
notes.notes:
Featuring Fabulously Furious Final Flourishes!	

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26407997/796415ddadcaeaeb335932626fc193d325254a18.png

Hey everyone,

We’re totally stoked to be unleashing the long-awaited Sundered Finisher Update, chock-full of delicious quality of life improvements and the badass titular finishing moves that will have you obliterating eldritch hordes in style! The  Sundered Finisher Update arrives automatically as a free update to all Steam players today. Important additional updates to Sundered are still to come!

Here’s what’s in store for y’all in the Finisher Update:


    Added a set of new combat moves we call Finishers. Once a certain number of melee attacks have been landed in a short time frame, a powerful Finisher attack is ready to be unleashed! Finishers are available from the start of the game
    Huge balance pass to make the game smoother and reduce moments where grind feels necessary: Reworked and improved early game pacing; Increased shard drops in the early game.
    Expanded the skill tree with new nodes and rebalanced some stat multipliers and perks.
    Defeated bosses can be fought again for reduced rewards.
    Added player markers to help locate the player in crowded or zoomed out locations (can be toggled in the options).
    Tweaked minimap legend so each icon is more easily recognizable.
    Modified tip system so as to not spoil content that is not yet accessible to the player.
    Reduced loading times and stabilized frame rate (hurray!).
    Other minor bug fixes.


Please remember that your feedback is crucial for us, so please do leave or update your review on our  Store page	, and strike up a conversation about this update with us on our  Forums! 

ICYMI: The "Not-A-Metroidvania" Bundle!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26407997/4507355ba11c2f5c53dfe7a7f9648809f3369396.png

Finally, don’t forget that the  Not-A-Metroidvania Bundle is still live, and that you stand to save a pretty penny on some of the best games of the-genre-that-shall-not-be-named, especially with the deeper Summer Sale discounts! 

Resist or Embrace.

- Rodrigue and the Thunder Lotus Team

notes.title: We're bringing Sundered to Kickstarter! (and have confirmed our release date!)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26407997/31a87522a054c3a2cc8d15703efcb70eabaefa0c.jpg

 Sundered Is On Kickstarter! 

Hey everyone! Huge news today, as we're revealing our Sundered Kickstarter campaign!

 --> Preview the Sundered Kickstarter campaign (and share it too!) 

We had a small, dedicated army of backers with us throughout the crucial testing phase of the Jotun project, so we know firsthand how crucial the input of enthusiastic alpha and beta players is for making a good game something special. To all the fans we've proudly recruited since day one, we want to be abundantly clear: we simply couldn't imagine completing Sundered without repeating that great Kickstarter experience.

In short, the campaign’s goal is to get *you* involved in the process. It's about polish, feedback and making Sundered the best it can be. We hope you'll check the campaign out, consider joining us for the alpha and/or beta, and share the campaign with any you believe might be interested.

We'll be live on Kickstarter on January 16th - we hope to see you then! In the meantime, don't forget to click on "Notify me on launch" on our Kickstarter page so you don't miss out!

 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26407997/2d42a095dae6d30affcbbc4dbd8a5f364814936c.png

 Sundered Will Be Out This Summer! 

We've included a production timeline on the Kickstarter page as well, officially revealing the release window for Sundered in the process! Set some time aside during the hot summer months to delve into Sundered's dark caverns: we'll be out in July 2017!

 --> Wishlist Sundered on Steam! 

Cheers, 

#ResistOrEmbrace 

- Rodrigue and the Thunder Lotus Team

notes.title: 2016/03/23 Patch Notes - Quality of life improvements
notes.notes:
The official patch has been live since yesterday, so here are the full patch notes.

PATCH NOTES


Added a Restart button during boss fights to reset an encounter.
Increased Thora's move speed while outside boss arenas. Speed during battles was left unchanged as to not affect the fights' difficulty.
Optimized assets in order to reduce install size and memory usage. This might result in a larger that usual download size for a patch.
Fixed a bug that could cause a crash [spoiler]during the Odin encounter[/spoiler] on lower end systems and on Linux.
Added support for a wider array of controllers.
Fixed some objects that were not linked to any sound slider and that thus played at maximum volume.

notes.title: 12/07/2015 Patch Notes - Achievements
notes.notes:
Steam integration

Added trading cards.
Added achievements. Completion achievements are retroactive, boss achievements aren't.
Added cloud save support.


Gameplay

Reduced damage sources in The Crater.
Added an extra Mimir's well in The Crater.
Made path to godshrine more obvious in The Crater.
Made fire jotun hitboxes more forgiving.


Performance

Reduced memory usage in the final fight (should prevent crash happening there).
Added higher resolution textures vines and nature jotun frames.
Tons of minor bug fixes and optimizations.
